messages:
maria: Quick async pulse — can owners confirm ship/slip/follow-ups for these OKR milestones?
1) Dedicated autoscale + burst (Milestone A)
2) Runtime p99 <= 120ms (Milestone B)
3) Private GA docs + install automation (Milestone C)
Please reply with: owner / status (shipped/slipped/at-risk) / next action.
aj: Milestone B — owner here. We shipped the core kernel optim backfill but p99 is still ~170ms on some 16k-seq tails. Status: at-risk. Next: land a small kernel perf patch + run e2e regression. ETA: EOW for patch, two-week rollout after canary.
devon: Milestone A — infra finished the scale controller; canary passed. Status: partially shipped to prod (20% capacity). Next: ramp schedule + runbooks. Need @kevin to sign off on quotas and billing tags.
kevin: Ack — I'll take billing tags. Also need a tiny doc on quota-limits; @maria can you confirm priority?
sara: Milestone C — docs mostly done but install script failing on a RHEL7 edge-case. Status: slipped (blocked by infra network for iptables rules). Next: open a short RFC and attach repro. ETA: +1 week if infra helps.
maria: Thanks — please capture blockers here. @devon can infra prioritize the iptables window?
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for prod-net on 2026-03-22 03:00-03:30 UTC. May affect Private GA installs. See: https://internal.ops/maintenance/345
devon: We can allocate a 2-hour validation window Mon to apply and test iptables changes. Need Sara to provide exact ports and a tiny test harness by EOD tomorrow.
sara: Will drop port list and test script to this thread by COB. Also pinging eng-sre for ephemeral host access.
aj: On the p99 front: kernel fix needs a code review (PR 4123). @kevin can you prioritise review? It's ~5 files, low-risk.
kevin: On it — I'll review today and flag any infra deps.
maria: Summary / action items:
- A: devon -> ramp + runbooks (prod ramp 20->60% this week).
- B: aj -> finish patch + tests; kevin -> review PR; ETA two weeks.
- C: sara -> fix install script + RFC; devon -> 2h validation window; ETA +1 week.
If anything slips again, prepare a canary rollback plan. Mark yourself done when you update the checklist. :thumbsup:
aj: Updated checklist and added PR link: https://git.redwood/pulls/4123
sara: Uploaded test script gist: https://gist.github.com/sara/rw-install-test and posted port list.
devon: Noted — scheduling 2h window and will post calendar invite.
maria: Great — if anyone is blocked on reviews or access reply here and I will escalate. Otherwise reconvene in weekly OKR sync on Friday.
